summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with hypotension during dialysis, preceded by antibiotic-related diarrhea and accidental intake of blood pressure medication before the session. She was fluid-resuscitated with improvement in symptoms. Workup showed no acute infection or abdominal pathology, with negative blood cultures and a normal CT abdomen and pelvis. Her supratherapeutic INR of 3.1 was managed by reducing warfarin dose to 2 mg daily. She remained stable, completed her inpatient dialysis, and was discharged home with instructions to monitor for recurrent diarrhea and to adhere to medication adjustments, including twice-daily tacrolimus dosing.
problems: Adverse effect of unspecified systemic antibiotic, initial encounter
